notes: PRD FR-4.3. Central rooftop-solar subsidy, tiered by system size.

VERIFY BEFORE QUOTING A RUPEE FIGURE TO ANYONE. Subsidy rates change by notification and the numbers below are from secondary reporting, not the scheme document. This file exists so that verification is a one-file edit (NFR-4), not a code change.
Tiers are marginal, like the tariff slabs: kwp_from is EXCLUSIVE, kwp_to is INCLUSIVE. A 3 kWp system therefore earns 2 x 30000 + 1 x 18000 = 78000, then the cap binds.
state_top_up is 0 pending confirmation of any TN-specific addition. Do not invent one.
PRD FR-4.4 subsidy_avoided -- the fiscal-side number -- is a Phase 2 concern and is not modelled here.

state_top_up.note: TN state component unconfirmed. Zero until sourced.

eligibility.note: Systems above max_kwp receive the capped amount, not a scaled one.
